escena: SCENE (setting up a shoot, rooftop in Mexico City, late afternoon, NO faces): THE SUBJECT OF THE PHOTOGRAPH IS THE SHADOW, not the person — verify it by these landmarks: the hard low sun throws a LONG, SHARP, GRAPHIC SHADOW of a crew member holding a camera rig, and that shadow occupies the centre and most of the frame, stretched across pale concrete; of the person themselves only the boots enter at the very top edge of the picture, nothing more. The shadow is the clearest, most detailed shape in the image — you can read the rig, the arms and the stance in it. Caught at the instant the shadow's arm lifts. 35mm at f/8, camera high looking down at the concrete. Everything is completely unbranded, no readable text anywhere.
